summary.objective: converge to a physically defined ABEP reference architecture (no further framework construction for its own sake)
summary.language: Python stays authoritative (orchestrator, evidence/provenance, validation, gates, schemas/builders/decisions); HallThruster.jl stays the Hall solver; optional Rust package abep_core (PyO3/maturin) only for measured hotspots; a Rust kernel is admitted only when Python-reference vs Rust discrepancies on frozen golden vectors, edge cases and randomized domain points stay inside a preregistered tolerance; Python wrappers keep identical I/O and every Rust kernel can be switched off
summary.freeze_rule: FROZEN_REFERENCE_FLIGHT_ARCHITECTURE only when architecture-level gates have sufficient evidence; until then INVESTIGATION_HYPOTHESIS
summary.optimizer_rule: hard constraints fail closed; a TBD evidence input is never converted into an assumed value to obtain an optimum; Pareto sets, not single optima; optimisation never changes evidence-gate status
summary.f6_condition: downstream ICP geometry search once P1/P2 evidence exists

implementation_lanes.fo_a9_7_f6_icp_geometry: F6 downstream ICP geometry synthesis (framework; search after P1/P2 evidence)
implementation_lanes.fo_a9_7_f7_f8_coupled_optimizer: F7 coupled architecture optimizer + F8 robust optimization (fail-closed)
implementation_lanes.fo_a9_7_rust_kernels: optional abep_core Rust kernels for measured hotspots (Python reference authoritative)
implementation_lanes.fo_a9_7_f9_freeze_candidate: F9 architecture freeze candidate (INVESTIGATION_HYPOTHESIS until gates have evidence)
implementation_lanes.fo_a9_7_consolidated_verification: one consolidated verification of the A9.7 batch

recorder_notes: Verification mode is not restated in A9.7; the A9.6 implementation-first pattern (hygiene per lane, one consolidated verification at the end) is applied. No merge to main is authorized by A9.7.

Rule 2 / goldens: existing abep_sim modules (intake, intake_tpmc, compressor.DragCompressor.size_for, reservoir) are not modified; the synthesis layer is new code (abep_sim/design/) that calls them, so golden benchmarks cannot move. The F3 'upgrade' is delivered as a new bounded design search beside size_for.
Rule 9: optional Rust comparisons must not add pytest skips; the Python reference path is always tested and the Rust parity check runs as a separate script/CI-optional step.

Evidence state that bounds what F5-F8 can compute today: the credible Hall set is empty and P5-N2 v1 is INCONCLUSIVE (no admitted Hall response map), so thrust T and T - D are NOT_EVALUATED for every design vector; ICP-45 is NOT_EVALUATED until I_d,max,H1 is registered and P1 data exist; the F6 geometry search needs P1/P2 evidence. These parts are implemented fail-closed and return NOT_EVALUATED, never an assumed value.
Formula lines with lost minus signs (F4 plenum balance) are recorded as the standard mass balance dm_s/dt = mdot_s,compressor - mdot_s,Hall - mdot_s,losses (recorder reading).
immutability: never edited after commit; later owner amendments are new addendum files
